title: fix(plugin-kanban): a focused card opens on Enter and Space, as a click does
body:
Fixes #12883
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A focused kanban card now opens on Enter and on Space, through the same `onCardClick` a pointer click takes. Only `SortableCard` in `packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx` changes, plus the `onCardClick` event type in the same file.

- **Enter** (keydown) and **Space** (keyup, as a native button activates) call `onCardClick(card, event)` with the key event. The Space press is `preventDefault`-ed so it does not scroll the board.
- **Only the card's own key counts:** a key whose target is an element inside the card (a link or input a field cell renders) is ignored (`event.target !== event.currentTarget`).
- **Role:** the card was a bare `listitem` that was also the tab stop. It is now a `button` (explicit; it is also the role dnd-kit gives a draggable) wrapped in a `listitem`. The APG shape for an activatable item in a list is a list item that contains the control, and a `button` cannot itself be the `listitem` its `role="list"` needs. The wrapper keeps `aria-label` = card title, so the list item stays named as before. The sortable node, the dnd-kit `attributes` / `listeners`, the transform, `aria-describedby` and `aria-label` stay on the focusable button.
- **Event type:** `onCardClick`'s second parameter is now `KanbanCardActivationEvent = React.MouseEvent | React.KeyboardEvent` (three spellings in this file; `KanbanBoardProps` is not exported from the package entry). The published faces (`ObjectKanbanSchema.onCardClick`, `ObjectKanbanComponentProps.onCardClick`, `KanbanRendererProps`) already type it `any`.
- **No keyboard drag:** no `KeyboardSensor`; keyboard drag stays held for the maintainer per objectui#12837.

## Measurements

- **Space is free.** In `@dnd-kit/core` 6.3.1 (`dist/core.esm.js`) only `KeyboardSensor.activators` binds a key (`onKeyDown`); `PointerSensor` binds `onPointerDown`, `TouchSensor` binds `onTouchStart`. The board builds pointer and touch only, which `dndInstructions-12837.test.tsx` pins, so the card's `listeners` carry no key handler. Its control "Space on a focused card starts no drag" stays green.
- **A1, the readers of the event.** Every reader takes only `target`, `metaKey`, `ctrlKey` and `button`:
  - `useOverlayAnchor().captureAnchor` (`@object-ui/components` `navigation-overlay.tsx`) reads `event.target`. For a key event that is the focused card, a valid anchor.
  - `useNavigationOverlay().handleClick` (`@object-ui/react`) reads `metaKey || ctrlKey || button === 1`.
  - Host handlers `handleRecordClick` in `ObjectDataPage.tsx` and `InterfaceListPage.tsx` (app-shell), and `ObjectView`'s `onRowClick`, read the same fields.
  - A key event carries `metaKey` / `ctrlKey` and has no `button`, so Ctrl/Cmd+Enter opens a new tab like Ctrl/Cmd+click, and a key never reads as a middle click.
- **PR #12882's description:** `aria-describedby` is still on the focusable element and still resolves to the bundle sentence in en and zh. The pin's `card()` helper now queries the `button` role, and its three assertions are unchanged and green.

## Pins

New: `packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/cardKeyboardActivation-12883.test.tsx` (real board, real `DndContext`, no mocks):

- (role) the card is a `button` inside the named `listitem` inside `role="list"`, with `tabindex="0"`
- (a) focused card + Enter calls `onCardClick` once, with that card and a `keydown` event
- (b) Space: the keydown is claimed and opens nothing; the keyup opens once
- (c) CONTROL: Enter / Space on a nested link and a nested input open nothing
- CONTROL: other keys (`a`, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown) open nothing
- (d) CONTROL: a pointer click calls `onCardClick` once, with a `click` event

The in-package pins that read the sortable node's own attributes (`aria-describedby`, `aria-disabled`, and the pointer-drag target) now query the `button`: `dndInstructions-12837`, `dndAnnouncements-12716` and `ObjectKanban.moveGrant-12082`. The pins that query the named `listitem` for card content need no change, including app-shell `listKanbanEveryRecord-12619`, which was run and is green.

**Ablation**, once, after commit `0550c733e4`, through `objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:

- The anchor `onKeyDown={(e) => {` was renamed to a data attribute: anchor x1 to x0, blob `e5e8881574f3` to `217dbcc095b9`.
- The new file went red, 2 failed / 4 passed: (a) Enter, and (b) Space, whose keydown is no longer claimed.
- Restore: blob after restore `e5e8881574f3` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. These tests import `../KanbanImpl` from source, so no dist is involved.

The config has no `projectService` / `parserOptions.project`, so it does no type-aware linting and this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.

The pre-12883 reading is kept as `PRE_REPAIR_PRE_12883` and a delta case pins the difference; 17/17 green. (Added by the seat.)
## Acceptance notes

- **Children of a `button` are presentational in ARIA.** A field cell that renders a link (url or email) sits inside the card's button, as it already sat inside a focusable element before. Keys on it are excluded from the card's open. This is the cost of the button role the order rules for Space activation; a `link` role would keep children semantic but has no Space activation.
- **dnd-kit's `aria-roledescription="sortable"` is unchanged**, so a screen reader says "sortable" where it would say "button". The role is still exposed and Enter / Space work. Changing that text is a separate wording decision. Carrier: none.
- **A comment in `ObjectKanban.tsx` is now stale.** It is on the `onCardClick` prop and says "`KanbanImpl` types the same channel as `React.MouseEvent`". That file is outside this order's file surface, so it is unchanged. Carrier: none.
- **The commit body says "Fixes objectui#12883".** Card relations are declared here in the PR body only; the commit cannot be rewritten because force-push is barred. The card it names is this PR's own.
